sequence.detail: Ricky Saints attacked Trick Williams and Rey Fenix during the original tag match, causing the disqualification
Penta emerged and requested a six-man tag team match
Penta, Trick Williams and Rey Fenix defeated Sami Zayn, Johnny Gargano and Ricky Saints

storylines.consequence: Trick Williams gains momentum ahead of his Undisputed WWE Title match against Sami Zayn

storylines.development: After the prior week's punt to Baron Corbin, Rhodes and Orton confronted each other; Nick Aldis booked Crown Jewel and Rhodes proposed a Last Man Standing stipulation
storylines.consequence: Crown Jewel match set with Last Man Standing stipulation

storylines.development: During a sit-down interview with Nick Aldis, CM Punk and Kevin Owens exchanged accusations over prior championship opportunities
storylines.consequence: Their match was announced for Brooklyn in two weeks

storylines.development: IYO SKY countered Raquel Rodriguez's interference during Chelsea Green's defense; after the match, Liv Morgan, Roxanne Perez and Rodriguez attacked Green and SKY, Tiffany Stratton intervened and nearly cashed in on Morgan before Judgment Day pulled Morgan away
storylines.consequence: Women's title and Money in the Bank tensions escalated

storylines.development: With the official distracted, Jade Cargill struck Tatum Paxley from ringside, allowing Michin to score the pin
storylines.consequence: Michin and B-Fab won the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship
